messages:
lina: quick q — for runtime config-only changes (batcher defaults, internal timeouts) do we bump patch or minor? e.g. 0.12.3 -> ???
raul: rule of thumb: patch for fixes / non-API-visible tweaks, minor if customer-observable behavior changes or opt-in flags change.
marta: agreed. also add an upgrade note if defaults change in a way that could break integrations.
lina: example: reduce default request timeout from 60s -> 30s. that seems breaking so minor?
raul: yeah, if a client relying on long timeouts could see errors -> minor. if it's purely perf tuning that doesn't change responses, patch.
noah: what about deps-only bumps where we pin a transitive tokenizer to fix a crash but it doesn't change our API — patch?
siva: deps-only that are invisible to users = patch. if the dependency changes output formatting or tokenization that affects user-visible outputs, treat as minor.
raul: also consider rollout risk: low-risk changes ok as patch, higher-risk -> minor plus canary windows.
lina: any convention for tagging hotfix vs normal patch? our CI currently creates tags like `v0.12.3` but sometimes we need a visible hotfix suffix.
raul: semver allows build metadata with a +, e.g. `0.12.4+hotfix.1`, but our git/tag tooling and release dashboards expect hyphenated tags for filtering. we've standardized on `v0.12.4-hotfix.1` in the past.
marta: decision proposal: 1) default to patch for non-API changes; 2) bump minor for behavioral/defaults/contract changes; 3) tag with `v` prefix and use `-hotfix.N` suffix for post-release fixes so tooling picks them up. I'll add to release playbook.
lina: ok i'll open a PR to update docs and add a checklist item: "classify change scope (patch/minor/major) + explain observable impact".
noah: small nit — add an entry for "deps pin churn" so engineers know when to combine multiple deps fixes into one patch release vs split them.
raul: +1. also add example matrix in the doc: code-only fix -> patch; default/behavior change -> minor; public API change -> major.

``` 
# semver examples for playbook
0.12.3 -> 0.12.4  # patch: bugfix, internal tuning
0.12.3 -> 0.13.0  # minor: default semantics or observable behavior change
0.12.3 -> 1.0.0   # major: breaking public API change
0.12.4-hotfix.1  # post-release hotfix tag for tooling
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v0.12.4-hotfix.1 -> canary cluster at 03:00 UTC. monitor #eng-oncall and the canary dashboard.
marta: pls attach release note draft to the PR and link any migration steps.
lina: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deployed v0.12.4-hotfix.1 to canary-prod-2 (link: https://ci.internal/deploys/2214509876)
noah: reminder: add a line in changelog about pinned tokenizer causing small delta in token counts so downstream evals are aware.
siva: cool — sounds like we have consensus. I'll update the playbook and ping this thread when the doc is live.
